hero-snow.alt: Abdullah alone on a floodlit sports field in heavy snow at night, arms spread wide, his footprints leading back across the pitch.

hero-talk.alt: Abdullah mid-sentence with a microphone at an exhibition booth, hands moving as he explains something.

saudi-graduation.caption: Hosting the 2024 graduation. Al-Rowad International Schools, Riyadh.

saudi-pcbuild-2.alt: Students working on an open desktop computer case and a bare motherboard at a workshop table.

saudi-street.alt: Abdullah sitting on a blue motorbike in a sunlit street with friends standing around.

car-bench.alt: The self-driving car on a bench: a Raspberry Pi, motor drivers and ultrasonic sensors wired onto a flat chassis, pliers beside it.

life-bike.alt: Abdullah standing with his fat-tyre e-bike on a campus path in winter.

ankara-lecture.alt: A lecture theatre at ODTU with three blackboards covered in handwritten analysis proofs, the lecturer at the podium.
